summary: Santander Holdings USA filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, announcing redemption of all 135,000 outstanding shares of its Fixed-Rate Reset Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series I, and the corresponding 5,400,000 depositary shares (NYSE: SNUS PF I) at $25.00 per depositary share on October 15, 2026. The redemption price excludes a regular quarterly dividend payable separately that same date to holders of record September 30, 2026. No advisor or board recommendation disclosed. This is a full capital-structure retirement that removes a preferred overhang; watch for funding replacement and any further capital actions.
